mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, p.zi, p.hao, p.dynasty, p.years, p.title, p.intro, p.story, p.story_title, p.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poem m WHERE m.poet_id = p.id) AS poem_count FROM poet p WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO poet (name, zi, hao, dynasty, years, title, intro, story, story_title, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{zi}, #{hao}, #{dynasty}, #{years}, #{title}, #{intro}, #{story}, #{storyTitle}, NOW())
